gloss: number of scheduled services; number of flights

definitions.gloss: number of scheduled services; number of flights
definitions.explanation: How many scheduled runs a transport service operates over a given period — flights, ferry sailings, long-distance buses, or delivery rounds. Usually counted per day or per week.

examples.japanese: {便数|びんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}った→減る：01985_heru⟧。
examples.english: The number of flights has decreased.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧あいだ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{便数|びんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}やされる→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧。
examples.english: The number of services is increased during the summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フェリー→フェリー：11168_ferii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{便数|びんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: The ferry to this island runs only a few times a day, so you should book early.

notes:
⟦{便|びん}→便：28160_bin⟧ (scheduled service, flight) + ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number). A practical word in travel and transport news, especially when services are being cut back or added.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {便数|びんすう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ / ⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: to have many / few services
- {便数|びんすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧: to increase the number of services
- {便数|びんすう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧: to cut services
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{便数|びんすう}: number of services per day

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本数|ほんすう}→本数：13154_honsuu⟧: number of runs — the usual word for trains and buses
- ⟦{運行|うんこう}→運行：14375_unkou⟧⟦{回数|かいすう}→回数：00139_kaisuu⟧: number of operations — more formal, used in official announcements
